scene_ab_same_actions.method: identical action sequences, identical env code and thresholds, only grounding/assets/allegro_floating.xml differs

summary.reading: the hook raises the box only 3 steps above the 5 cm bar and reaches that peak with ZERO finger force - the box is launched, not carried. Its A3b pass on 4ee6f1d was the apex step of that launch happening to have no contact, i.e. a single-step coincidence, consistent with the p0(4d) adjudication that the passing set has measure ~zero. On 1b0f13f that coincidence is gone: the same actions leave the box in contact with the pedestal at their own peak.
